body:
Please add the specific documentation change you made to this issue so a maintainer can review the proposed contribution. Rich currently limits pull requests to collaborators. See [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md) and, if you used AI, [AI_POLICY.md](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/blob/master/AI_POLICY.md). A related earlier request is #4029.

<sub>Automated first-response triage (rich-triage skill). A maintainer will review.</sub>
